author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Story (hernia) to be sidelined through All-Star break
desc: Trevor Story is expected to be sidelined through the All-Star break.
impact: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said he does not expect Story to go on a rehab assignment before the All-Star break. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Shaw dealing with wrist soreness
desc: Matt Shaw came out of Sunday's game against the Brewers with wrist soreness.
impact: It explains why Shaw was pinch-hit for late in the game. He'll figure to be further evaluated on Monday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brandon Woodruff strong on mound in no-decision
desc: Brandon Woodruff allowed one hit and two walks while striking out six over 5 2/3 scoreless innings in Sunday's loss to the Cubs.
impact: Woodruff continues an impressive stretch on the mound since returning from injury, holding opponents scoreless in each of his last two trips to the mound. The right-hander offers manager Pat Murphy another impactful starting option behind Jacob Misiorowski and Kyle Harrison in the Brewers rotation, carrying a 2.59 ERA and 0.84 WHIP with a 2-1 record and 8.9 K/9 ratio across eight starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Elly De La Cruz suffers sprained ankle Sunday
desc: Elly De La Cruz sprained his ankle in Sunday's game against the Pirates.
impact: De La Cruz had his ankle worked on before he finished the game. He'll be re-evaluated on Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eugenio Suarez (hand/wrist) has X-rays return inconclusive
desc: Eugenio Suarez had X-rays return inconclusive on his hand/wrist injury.
impact: Suarez is slated to be further scanned on Monday. He remains day-to-day.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Gary Sanchez goes yard in loss to Cubs
desc: Gary Sanchez went 1-for-4 in Sunday's loss to the Cubs with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Sanchez continues a solid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in seven of his last 10 contests. The 33-year-old remains one of the more inconsistent bats when in the Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy, hitting .220 with eight home runs, 23 runs scored, and 22 RBI, through 48 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Anthony Kay labors in abbreviated outing Sunday
desc: Anthony Kay allowed four earned runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out two over 3 2/3 innings in Sunday's loss to the Royals.
impact: Kay has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last five contests. The left-hander has fought inconsistent command at times for manager Will Venable, posting a 4.50 ERA and 1.43 WHIP with a 6-3 record and 2.1 K/BB ratio through 17 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tristan Peters swipes base in loss to Royals
desc: Tristan Peters went 1-for-4 in Sunday's loss to the Royals with one stolen base.
impact: Peters has fought consistency issues at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last 11 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more stable options in a streaky White Sox lineup, slashing .284 with four home runs, 28 runs scored, 30 RBI, and five stolen bases through 78 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Miguel Vargas goes deep in loss to Royals
desc: Miguel Vargas went 2-for-2 in a loss to the Royals with a home run, two walks, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Vargas has caught fire again at the plate, registering hits in each of his last six contests. The infielder continues to offer manager Will Venable one of the more explosive bats in a streaky White Sox lineup, carrying an .866 OPS with 19 home runs, 56 runs scored, 52 RBI, and 10 stolen bases across 81 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grayson Rodriguez (back) works four innings in rehab start
desc: Grayson Rodriguez allowed one run in four innings in a rehab start for Low-A Rancho Cucamonga on Sunday.
impact: Rodriguez allowed five hits and a walk and struck out four. He'll likely still require at least one or two more starts on his rehab assignment.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ryan Feltner steady on mound in no-decision
desc: Ryan Feltner allowed one earned run on five hits over six innings in Sunday's 3-2 loss to the Twins.
impact: Feltner continues a solid stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in six of his last seven trips to the mound. The 29-year-old has turned things around on the mound after a dismal start to the season, posting a 4.42 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with a 2-2 record and 1.8 K/BB ratio through 11 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Solak re-signs with Padres on minor league deal
desc: The Padres re-signed INF/OF Nick Solak to a minor league contract.
impact: Solak returns to the Padres organization after testing free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yandy Diaz (shoulder) expects to play Tuesday
desc: Yandy Diaz told reporters he expects to be able to play Tuesday against the Royals.
impact: Diaz left Sunday's game early with a left shoulder strain. He'll continue to be further evaluated into Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Roman Anthony transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Red Sox transferred Roman Anthony to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Romy Gonzalez. Anthony remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Isaac Paredes goes yard in win over Tigers
desc: Isaac Paredes went 3-for-5 in a win over the Tigers with a home run, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Paredes continues a torrid stretch at the plate, driving in runs in seven of his last eight contests. The 27-year-old remains one of many streaky options in the Astros lineup, hitting .256 with 11 home runs, 34 runs scored, and 45 RBI through 79 games.
